name: browser-use
headline: Open Agent - AI Agent Orchestrator
short_description: Self-hosted orchestrator for AI autonomous agents. Run Claude Code & Open Code in isolated Linux workspaces. Manage skills, configs, and encrypted secrets with a git repo. Ideal for developers and operations teams.
author: Th0rgal

sections.overview:
sandboxed.sh is a self-hosted cloud orchestrator designed for AI coding agents, enabling developers and operations teams to run multiple agent runtimes—including Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini, and Grok—in isolated Linux containers. Each agent executes in its own containerized environment using systemd-nspawn, ensuring workspaces are scoped securely with dedicated directories. The platform centralizes skills, tools, rules, and configurations in a git-backed library, allowing version control and reproducible deployments. Features include real-time mission monitoring, scheduled automations with cron-like triggers, model routing with provider fallback chains, and optional MCP registry integration for additional tool servers. Installation options span Docker (for rapid deployment on any OS) and native Ubuntu 24.04 setup (for production performance), making it suitable for local inference workloads, multi-day unattended operations, and sensitive data analysis.
Autonomous code generation and testing: point an agent at a GitHub issue to write code, run tests, and open PRs automatically
Long-running ML operations: give agents SSH access to run model training and fine-tuning unattended over days
Local sensitive data analysis: process sequenced DNA or proprietary datasets with local inference, no cloud exposure
Multi-agent orchestration: coordinate Claude Code, OpenCode, and other runtimes on shared infrastructure with skill libraries
